text_policy: Archive the complete supplied source and exact album track slices, including credits, style prompts, spelling, punctuation, and stage directions. Album lyric bodies are the literal contents of their text fences. No lines are reconstructed or reassigned.
epistemic_policy: Use the fixed catalog vocabulary with claim-specific status. Definitions and normative standards are distinct from observations, conditional derivations, hypotheses, and unresolved questions. Coupling does not count against MI. Sung certainty is not independent measurement.
attribution_policy: Retain every explicit track contribution credit; named performance voices are not substituted for credited writers.
